wiki.title: Brad Overcash
wiki.extract: Brad Overcash (born 1980 or 1981) is an American politician who has served as a member of the North Carolina Senate since January 1, 2023. A Republican from Belmont, he represents the 43rd district. Overcash is a graduate of University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and the University of Mississippi.
